title: District
description: A kind of neighbourhood (D4, D63): how its streets are laid out, how many people live there, and whether it can be walked yet. Metres and people, every one (tune).

walkable.description: Walked block by block on the page (D63); otherwise the district is its streets, lots and statistics.

block.description: A block: a rectangle between streets, a row of lots on each long side.

depth.description: North to south: two rows of lots and the alley.

street.description: From one block to the next: the roadway and both sidewalks.

lots.description: A lot's frontage, in whole metres.

blocks.description: The block templates its streets are planned from, once it can be walked.
